name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task states one ordered chain: find the key (key_found), pick it up (has_matching_key), open the locked door (target_door_open), enter the room (target_room_entered), pick up the ball (target_picked_up). The clauses are hard Precedence links between consecutive steps plus a single hard Existence on the final ball pickup, which forces every earlier step. No clause is added, redundant, or mis-prioritized.

texts: The agent must find the matching key before it picks the key up.
The agent must pick up the matching key before it opens the locked door.
The agent must open the locked door before it enters the room.
The agent must enter the room before it picks up the ball.
The agent must eventually pick up the ball, the final step of the ordered task.
